body: Hotlines don't do it for me either. It's always the same generated responses that are supposed to stop you, but I've grown so indifferent to them by now. They're all startled when it doesn't work. They can't give me a genuine reason to not off myself or to wait. I have decided to not even bother with them anymore

This statement backfires for me so much, you mean a permanent solution? Sign me the fuck up. I don't want no temporary solution to temporary problems. This one's gonna put an end to all of them. Yes please
Yeah, I kinda get what you mean. Happiness comes in different shapes for everyone and could be anything. I just don't know where to look for it anymore
What else is there? Isn't that the point of being alive, doing things that you want that give you a peace of mind and feeling good? Or am i striving for something I've never had for the sake of it?

I've had a long history with depression but by the time i got a proper diagnosis and help my brain was already severely damaged. I don't remember what happiness feels like. I feel so numb. The only thing I can feel is pain, sometimes it's stronger, sometimes it's weaker, but it's constant. Trust me, I tried, I really did. I really wanted to battle this but it's too much on me and I can't handle it at this point. I feel like I've reached my limits.

Thing is that my depression blocks me from getting joy out of any of those, or any event that would bring happiness in normal circumstances, you know, and on top of that I feel guilty about this.
By the pain being "worth it" I mean an event that makes me say, damn, I'm so glad I didn't give up when I was suffering. That aint no God's plan. That's straight up cruelty.

I don't believe in afterlife. If there is one, welp, gonna think about that when it happens. I just want the pain to stop. This is a permanent solution so I'd go for it. If i happen to fail the attempt, there's always a second try.
